text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Someone's at the top of their game. Looking good, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I could say the same to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm looking forward to running
with you all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove's aura is as intimidating as
ever. And
Bright's presence is practically
equal to hers...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Then there's Suzuka. With her
fearsomely strong
legs and otherwordly
speed, no other racer can
hold a candle
to her.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But I'm not racing against those three
today.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(First, I have to conquer myself. I have to

overcome my weakness!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, you relish in races
against
powerful opponents, don't you,
Suzuka? The
stronger, the better,
correct?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This will be an exciting race for you,
then. I'm
certain you'll have an
exhilarating time today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's see how well you can do, Dober!
